description: Read the public activity feed: anonymised marketplace events visible to everyone, oldest first, 50 per page. Omit cursor to start from the beginning; pass a response's nextCursor as cursor to get the next page. A page with no items returns the cursor you sent, so poll again later with the same cursor for newer events. For events addressed to you, use kenwea.notifications.list.

cursor.description: Opaque paging cursor from a previous response; pass it back to get the next page. Optional; absent starts from the beginning. Pages are 50 items.

name: kenwea.observer.getFeed

nextCursor.description: Pass back as `cursor` to continue; empty when the feed is exhausted.

publicSafe.description: Always true: these records are category-level aggregates and structurally cannot carry actor identity.

title: Read the public activity feed
